newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-BRAWL HALTS KORAC CUP GAME.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BRAWL HALTS KORAC CUP GAME.

text.p: A Korac Cup match between Greek club Aris and Besiktas of Turkey had to be abandoned on Wednesday after fighting broke out between rival players.
The brawl erupted in the 18th minute with Aris leading 40-31.
Besiktas's American forward Gary Alexander and Aris's Dinos Angelidis began scuffling and other players quickly joined in.
Police eventually restored order but officials refused to restart the game after Greek fans, incensed by the incidents, hoisted a banner reading "Greece's capital is Constantinople".
Most Greeks refer to the modern Turkish city of Istanbul as Constantinople, the city's Byzantine name.
